scares.description: A figure is seen moving in the reflection of the TV.
Katie opens the bedroom door and the scene abruptly changes to a close up of the television.
The scene suddenly changes to Katie’s horribly contorted face.
The reflection from the TV appears to distort.
The mysterious long haired girl grabs Rachel’s arm.
A centipede crawls along a piece of paper.
A hand emerges from under the water to grab Rachel.
The girl from the TV moves extremely fast towards Noah.
